name: Shitappa-kun
source:
He is a low-ranking member of a band of bandits. 

His distinguishing feature is his afro hair.

As a low-ranking member, he is also forced to carry out kidnappings. 
He often can't have sex with the girls he captures.

But if he plays his cards right, something good might happen...
